description.value: The Castlegar and District Community Complex is a publicly operated recreation facility run by the Regional District of Central Kootenay, serving residents and visitors in the Castlegar area. As a sports centre, it is a practical stop for touring cyclists looking to access indoor recreation amenities in this hub city along the Kootenay River. The complex is one of several RDCK-managed recreation facilities in the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific RDCK webpage for this facility returns a '404 Page not found' error, so no amenity details can be confirmed from website content. However, the RDCK website navigation menus across all fetched subpages consistently list 'Castlegar & District Community Complex' as an active facility under Parks & Recreation > Recreation, confirming the facility is real and operated by the Regional District of Central Kootenay. All amenity fields default to null due to the failed page fetch; OSM tags provide only basic contact/identifier data with no amenity detail.
concerns: The OSM website URL returns a '404 Page not found' error on the RDCK site — the page may have moved or been removed during a site reorganisation. No facility-specific amenity information could be retrieved.
The OSM community field lists 'Crescent Valley' but the facility is in Castlegar; this may be a tagging or administrative boundary artefact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible community sports complex actively listed on the RDCK website; a legitimate stop for touring cyclists seeking recreation facilities in Castlegar.

wow_evidence: Primary RDCK rec complex for the Castlegar area; pool with hot tub/steam room earns the after-ride band. Cluster parent (dupe 107950dd32, satellite 82ac8becf6).
blurb: Castlegar's recreation complex: rinks, fitness, and pool with hot tub and steam room.
